question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Acts of the Indian Constitution facilitated the appointment of the same person as governor for two or more states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7th Constitutional Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **7th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1956** was a significant amendment to the **Indian Constitution** that brought about major changes in the political and administrative structure of India.
 
• This amendment facilitated the appointment of the **same person as governor** for two or more states.
 
• The provision for such appointments was included under **Article 153** of the Indian Constitution, which deals with the position of governors in states.
 
• The amendment was part of the reorganization of states in India, which aimed to address linguistic and administrative concerns.
 
• The objective was to ensure better coordination and efficiency in the administration of states, especially in cases where states were geographically proximate or shared common issues.
 
• It also aimed at reducing administrative expenses by appointing a single governor for multiple states where feasible.
 
• The **7th Amendment** is a landmark reform that contributed to the restructuring of states and the establishment of a more organized governance framework in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **5th Constitutional Amendment Act**__

 __
 
• The **5th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1955** focused on the procedures related to the reorganization of states.
 
• It amended **Article 3**, which lays down the process for the formation of new states or the alteration of areas, boundaries, or names of existing states.
 
• This amendment ensured that the views of the state legislature concerned are considered within a specified timeline.
 
 
 
• **8th Constitutional Amendment Act**__
 __
 
• The **8th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1960** dealt with the reservation of seats in Parliament and state legislatures for the Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs).
 
• It extended the reservation of seats for SCs and STs and special representation for the Anglo-Indian community for a further period of ten years.
 
 
 
• **10th Constitutional Amendment Act**__
 
 
• The **10th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1961** was enacted to incorporate the **territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli** into the Union of India.
 
• This amendment added **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** as a Union Territory under the First Schedule of the Constitution.
